Dear Mr DURAND,

Thank you for your email.

To reply to MARTIN Property's defence, I will need the following documents: the signed practical completion certificate, the site meeting minutes for the last three months and the written exchanges about the snagging items.

Could you send them to me by the end of the week? The case management conference is listed in ten days.

Kind regards,

Claire DURAND
Durand & Martin Solicitors

Dear Ms ZORVAL,

The default judgment has been served on ORLANDEC Trading and the High Court Enforcement Officer has served a notice of enforcement. The debtor has seven clear days to pay.

Failing payment, the enforcement agent may take control of the debtor's goods and sell them to satisfy the judgment.

I will update you as soon as that period expires.

Kind regards,

Claire DURAND

Dear Mr KERVILAC,

On a renewal under the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954, the new rent is assessed at open market value. To support a higher figure, we will need evidence of how the area has changed.

I suggest gathering what you already have (road improvements, the new tram line, footfall figures, recent lettings nearby) before our meeting.

Kind regards,

Claire DURAND
